WITH AlamedaCounty AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.Charter,
    s.LowGrade,
    s.HighGrade,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS FreeMealRate,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] - (SELECT AVG([Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda') AS FreeMealRateDeviation,
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
      ELSE 'No SAT Data'
    END AS SATPerformanceLevel
  FROM 
    schools s
  JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  JOIN 
    satscores fs ON s.CDSCode = fs.cds
  WHERE 
    s.County = 'Alameda'
),
HighestFreeMealRate AS (
  SELECT 
    CDSCode,
    MAX(FreeMealRate) AS MaxFreeMealRate
  FROM 
    AlamedaCounty
  GROUP BY 
    CDSCode
)
SELECT 
  ac.CDSCode,
  ac.School,
  ac.Charter,
  ac.LowGrade,
  ac.HighGrade,
  ac.FreeMealRate,
  ac.FreeMealRateDeviation,
  ac.SATPerformanceLevel
FROM 
  AlamedaCounty ac
JOIN 
  HighestFreeMealRate hrm ON ac.CDSCode = hrm.CDSCode AND ac.FreeMealRate = hrm.MaxFreeMealRate;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] AS EligibleFreeRate
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SchoolType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY 
    EligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    s.OpenDate,
    s.StatusType,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FreeMealRate,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPMRate,
    sats.AvgScrRead,
    sats.AvgScrMath,
    sats.AvgScrWrite,
    sats.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High FRPM'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
        ELSE 'Low FRPM'
    END AS FRPMCategory
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
    AND s.Charter = 1
    AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` DESC;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.StreetAbr,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailStrAbr,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailZip,
    s.MailState,
    s.Website,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FRPM_Percentage,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPM_Count,
    sats.AvgScrRead,
    sats.AvgScrMath,
    sats.AvgScrWrite,
    sats.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 70 AND sats.NumGE1500 >= 20 THEN 'Highly Unexpectedly Well'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 30 AND sats.NumGE1500 < 10 THEN 'Highly Unexpectedly Poorly'
        ELSE 'Expected Performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sats ON f.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
    AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
ORDER BY 
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

    s.County,
    s.School,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,
    s.Charter,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 60 OR f.NumGE1500 > 30 AS Eligible,
    f.AvgScrRead + f.AvgScrMath + f.AvgScrWrite AS TotalSAT,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS FRPMLevel
FROM

JOIN

WHERE

ORDER BY

SELECT

FROM schools s

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.District,
    s.County,
    s.Charter,
    s.FundingType,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgScrRead,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) AS AvgScrMath,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgScrWrite,
    AVG(ss.NumTstTakr) AS AvgNumTstTakr,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(ss.NumTstTakr) < 50 THEN 'Under 50 testers'
        WHEN AVG(ss.NumTstTakr) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100 testers'
        ELSE '100-250 testers'
    END AS TestingVolumeCategory
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 
    AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' 
    AND s.County = 'Fresno' 
    AND ss.NumTstTakr <= 250
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.District, s.County, s.Charter, s.FundingType;

JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode 
WHERE 
    s.StatusType = 'Active' 
    AND sa.NumTstTakr >= 10 
ORDER BY 
    sa.AvgScrMath DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
    AVG(Enrollment) AS AverageEnrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Charter School (Y/N) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CharterSchools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Charter School (Y/N) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonCharterSchools,
    AVG(`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS AveragePovertyRate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `District Name`) AS NumberOfDistricts,
    AVG(AvgScrRead) AS AverageSATRead,
    AVG(AvgScrMath) AS AverageSATMath,
    AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS AverageSATWrite,
    MAX(Enrollment) AS LargestSchoolEnrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighPovertySchools
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    `County Name` = 'Amador' 
    AND Low Grade = '9' 
    AND High Grade = '12';

SELECT 
    AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS AvgFreeMealPct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NumCharter,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NumNonCharter,
    AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) AS AvgSATRead,
    AVG(T2.AvgScrMath) AS AvgSATMath,
    AVG(T2.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgSATWrite,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VeryHighFreeMeal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` BETWEEN 500 AND 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighFreeMeal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` BETWEEN 300 AND 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ModerateFreeMeal
FROM 
    frpm AS T1
JOIN 
    schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores AS T3 ON T2.CDSCode = T3.cds
WHERE 
    T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700 AND T2.County = 'Los Angeles';

humboldt AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_free_schools,

  FROM

  JOIN

  WHERE

)
SELECT

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    AVG(c.A11) AS average_salary,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_clients,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS active_loans
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
LEFT JOIN 
    account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'F'
    AND d.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
    AND l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY 
    d.district_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(c.client_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    average_salary DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(client_id) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE gender = 'M' AND A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND A11 > 8000;

WITH FemaleClients AS (
  SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.district_id,
    AVG(d.A11) AS avg_salary
  FROM 
    client c
  JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE 
    c.gender = 'F'
  GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.district_id
),
OldestClient AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    MIN(birth_date) AS min_birth_date
  FROM 
    client
  GROUP BY 
    client_id
),
LowestSalary AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(avg_salary) AS min_salary
  FROM 
    FemaleClients
),
HighestSalary AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(avg_salary) AS max_salary
  FROM 
    FemaleClients
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM OldestClient ORDER BY min_birth_date LIMIT 1)) AS account_number,
  (SELECT max_salary FROM HighestSalary) - (SELECT min_salary FROM LowestSalary) AS salary_gap;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE T3.birth_date = (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date)
    FROM client
)
AND T3.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
    )
)
AND T3.A11 = (
    SELECT MAX(A11)
    FROM client
);

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS region,
    c.gender,
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday(c.birth_date) - julianday('1970-01-01') < 30 * 365 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN julianday(c.birth_date) - julianday('1970-01-01') BETWEEN 30 * 365 AND 50 * 365 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_group,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2, c.gender, age_group
ORDER BY 
    d.A2, c.gender, age_group;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    AVG(l.duration) AS average_loan_duration,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount,
    COUNT(cc.card_id) AS credit_card_count
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A'
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    card cc ON d.disp_id = cc.disp_id
WHERE 
    a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.type = 'DISPONENT'
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'APPROVED' AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a

SELECT 
    AVG(JULIANDAY(T1.date) - JULIANDAY(T3.birth_date)) / 365 AS average_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id) AS total_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T4.status = 'A' THEN T1.account_id END) AS successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T4.status = 'D' THEN T1.account_id END) AS currently_in_debt,
    MIN(JULIANDAY(T1.date)) AS earliest_opening_year,
    MAX(JULIANDAY(T1.date)) AS latest_opening_year
FROM 
    account AS T1
JOIN 
    disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN 
    client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN 
    loan AS T4 ON T1.account_id = T4.account_id
JOIN 
    district AS T5 ON T3.district_id = T5.district_id
WHERE 
    T3.gender = 'F' 
    AND T3.birth_date < '1950-01-01' 
    AND T5.A2 = 'Sokolov' 
    AND T3.client_id = T2.client_id;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday(c.birth_date) + 365 * 30 > julianday(card.issued) THEN 'Mature'

    END AS borrower_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'Active'

    END AS loan_status
FROM

JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    card.issued = '1994-03-03'
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2
ORDER BY 
    c.gender, AVG(t.amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    a.date AS account_open_date,
    julianday(t.date) - julianday(a.date) AS days_open,
    c.gender,
    julianday(t.date) - julianday(c.birth_date) AS age_at_transaction,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = a.account_id AND date <= t.date) AS total_transactions_up_to_date,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE account_id = a.account_id)) AS number_of_cards_issued,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id = a.account_id AND date < t.date) AS had_loan_before_transaction
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    t.date = '1998-10-14' AND t.amount = 840 AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A10 AS average_salary_rank,
    d.A11 AS unemployment_rank,
    julianday(l.date) - julianday(a.date) AS account_age_before_loan,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS total_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_clients,
    AVG(julianday(l.date) - julianday(c.birth_date)) AS average_age,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.date < l.date
WHERE 
    l.date = '1994-08-25'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2, d.A3, d.A10, d.A11;

SELECT 
    c.client_id, 
    c.gender, 
    c.birth_date, 
    d.A2, 
    d.A3, 
    d.A4, 
    d.A5, 
    d.A6, 
    d.A7, 
    d.A8, 
    d.A9, 
    d.A10, 
    d.A11, 
    d.A12, 
    d.A13, 
    d.A14, 
    d.A15, 
    d.A16, 
    t.trans_id, 
    t.date, 
    t.type, 
    t.operation, 
    t.amount, 
    t.balance, 
    t.k_symbol, 
    t.bank, 
    t.account, 
    l.loan_id, 
    l.date AS loan_date, 
    l.amount AS loan_amount, 
    l.duration, 
    l.payments, 
    l.status, 
    o.order_id, 
    o.date AS order_date, 
    o.bank_to, 
    o.account_to, 
    o.amount AS order_amount, 
    o.k_symbol AS order_k_symbol
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE 
    ca.issued = '1996-10-21'
ORDER BY 
    t.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date)
    FROM client
    WHERE district_id = (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district
        ORDER BY A11 DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
);

SELECT t1.amount
FROM trans t1
JOIN account a ON t1.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
ORDER BY t1.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE dis.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT T2.disp_id
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.amount = 5100 AND T1.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS total_accounts,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.frequency = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 END) AS total_deposits,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.frequency = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 END) AS total_withdrawals,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_incoming_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_outgoing_transactions,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions,
    AVG(c.age) AS average_client_age,
    MIN(c.age) AS min_client_age,
    MAX(c.age) AS max_client_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.gender) AS number_of_client_genders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) AS number_of_client_districts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.district_id) AS number_of_account_districts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) / 4 AS quarterly_account_openings
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    d.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
    AND a.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
    AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id AS account_district_id,
    a.frequency,
    a.date AS account_open_date,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
    MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount,
    MIN(t.amount) AS min_transaction_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) AS distinct_transaction_types,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loans,
    AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount,
    MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount,
    MIN(l.amount) AS min_loan_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.k_symbol) AS distinct_loan_types
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'F' 
    AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date;

SELECT 
    c.birth_date,
    julianday(l.date) - julianday(c.birth_date) AS age_at_loan,
    d.A2 AS location,
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS expense_to_income_ratio,
    MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance,
    MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id)) AS credit_cards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND loan_id != l.loan_id) AS previous_loans
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T3.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY T1.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A4 AS number_of_inhabitants,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS total_number_of_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_male_clients,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.client_id)) AS percentage_of_male_clients
FROM 
    district d
JOIN 
    client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE 
    d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
GROUP BY 
    d.district_id, d.A2, d.A4
ORDER BY 
    d.A4 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ((T1.balance - T2.balance) / T2.balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM 
    trans AS T1
JOIN 
    trans AS T2
ON 
    T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE 
    T1.date = '1998-12-27'
    AND T2.date = '1993-03-22'
    AND T1.account_id IN (
        SELECT 
            account_id
        FROM 
            loan
        WHERE 
            date = '1993-07-05'
        ORDER BY 
            date
        LIMIT 1
    );

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS region,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.amount)) * 100 AS percentage_paid_without_issues,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id)) * 100 AS percentage_completed,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN (l.payments * l.duration) - l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS average_interest_paid_successful,
    AVG((l.payments * l.duration) - l.amount) AS average_interest_paid_all
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY 
    d.A2;

WITH loan_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.A2 AS region,
    CASE
      WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
      WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_loans
  FROM
    loan l
  JOIN
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE
    l.amount < 100000
  GROUP BY
    d.A2, loan_size
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_running_loans,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans
  FROM
    loan l
  WHERE
    l.amount < 100000
)
SELECT
  ls.region,
  ls.loan_size,
  (ls.running_loans * 100.0 / ls.total_loans) AS region_percentage,
  (ls.running_loans * 100.0 / os.total_running_loans) AS overall_percentage
FROM
  loan_stats ls
CROSS JOIN
  overall_stats os
ORDER BY
  ls.region, ls.loan_size;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A10 AS urban_inhabitant_ratio,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS number_of_loans,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    AVG(l.duration) AS average_loan_duration,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defaulted_loans
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    a.issued LIKE '1993%'
    AND t.operation = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2, d.A3, d.A10, c.gender, c.birth_date;

SELECT 
    c.client_id, 
    c.gender, 
    c.birth_date, 
    a.account_id, 
    a.frequency
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE 
    a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
    AND dis.A2 = 'east Bohemia';

WITH PrachaticeAccounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
TransactionStats AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
LoanInfo AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
CustomerCategory AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, 
         CASE 
           WHEN l.loan_count > 0 AND t.transaction_count > 10 THEN 'High Activity'
           WHEN l.loan_count > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
           WHEN t.transaction_count > 10 THEN 'Active Customer'
           ELSE 'Regular Customer'
         END AS customer_category
  FROM PrachaticeAccounts a
  LEFT JOIN TransactionStats t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoanInfo l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
),
NetBalance AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name, 
         t.total_income, t.total_expense, t.transaction_count, l.loan_count, cc.customer_category,
         (t.total_income - t.total_expense) AS net_balance
  FROM PrachaticeAccounts a
  JOIN TransactionStats t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN LoanInfo l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN CustomerCategory cc ON a.account_id = cc.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT * FROM NetBalance ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    d.A12 AS unemployment_rate,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments,
    l.status,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Running - Issues'
        WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'Finished - Issues'
        ELSE 'Running - OK'
    END AS status_description,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE district_id = l.district_id AND loan_id <= l.loan_id) AS loan_rank
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    l.loan_id = 4990;

WITH avg_salary AS (
  SELECT AVG(A11) AS national_avg FROM district
),
high_income_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A11 > (SELECT national_avg FROM avg_salary)
),
loan_details AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region,
    AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
  FROM 
    account a
  JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE 
    l.amount > 300000
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id, d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3
),
income_classification AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'
      WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'
      ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category
  FROM 
    account a
  LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id
),
transaction_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_income
  FROM 
    account a
  LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id
),
savings_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS savings_ratio
  FROM 
    account a
  LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id
),
ranked_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region,
    l.avg_loan_amount,
    l.total_loan_amount,
    l.loan_count,
    i.income_category,
    t.total_income,
    t.total_expense,
    t.net_income,
    s.savings_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY l.total_loan_amount DESC) AS rank
  FROM 
    account a
  JOIN 
    loan_details l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN 
    income_classification i ON a.account_id = i.account_id
  JOIN 
    transaction_activity t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN 
    savings_ratio s ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE 
    (t.net_income > 0 OR t.total_income = 0)
    AND a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM high_income_districts)
)
SELECT 
  * 
FROM 
  ranked_accounts 
WHERE 
  rank <= 100;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments,
    l.status,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    c.district_id,
    t.trans_id,
    t.date AS trans_date,
    t.type AS trans_type,
    t.operation,
    t.amount AS trans_amount,
    t.balance,
    t.k_symbol,
    t.bank,
    t.account,
    ((l.payments - l.amount) / l.amount * 100) AS interest_rate
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    l.duration = 60
ORDER BY 
    d.A11 DESC, 
    l.amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS state,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A15) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM 
    district d
JOIN 
    account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN 
    disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    l.status = 'D';

WITH monthly_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decin_count,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_amount,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM 
    trans t
  JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  GROUP BY 
    month
),
yearly_average AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(decin_count) AS avg_decin_percentage
  FROM 
    monthly_transactions
)
SELECT 
  mt.month,
  (mt.decin_count * 100.0 / mt.total_transactions) AS decin_percentage,
  mt.average_amount,
  mt.total_amount,
  CASE 
    WHEN (mt.decin_count * 100.0 / mt.total_transactions) > ya.avg_decin_percentage THEN 'Above'
    WHEN (mt.decin_count * 100.0 / mt.total_transactions) < ya.avg_decin_percentage THEN 'Below'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS comparison
FROM 
  monthly_transactions mt
CROSS JOIN 
  yearly_average ya;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYBER' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYBER' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS number_of_loans,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2
ORDER BY 
    total_transactions DESC, net_cash_flow DESC;

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_count
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY female_count DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS withdrawal_count
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY withdrawal_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE dis.A3 = 'South Bohemia' AND ca.card_id IS NULL;

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS active_loan_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY active_loan_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(loan.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M';

SELECT T1.A2, T1.A13
FROM district AS T1
ORDER BY T1.A13 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A8 AS population,
    d.A16 AS crimes_1996,
    (d.A16 - d.A15) * 100.0 / d.A15 AS crime_increase_percentage,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS accounts_opened
FROM 
    district d
LEFT JOIN 
    account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE 
    d.A16 IS NOT NULL AND d.A15 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    d.A16 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    AVG(balance) AS average_negative_balance,
    MAX(amount) AS maximum_withdrawal_amount,
    AVG(COUNT(card_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS average_number_of_cards_per_account,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_gold_cards,
    AVG(JULIANDAY('2000-01-01') - JULIANDAY(client.birth_date)) / 365 AS average_owner_age,
    client.gender
FROM 
    trans
JOIN 
    account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN 
    card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE 
    trans.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
    AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    AND trans.balance < 0
GROUP BY 
    client.gender;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.status = 'APPROVED';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    AVG(l.amount - l.payments * l.duration) AS average_remaining_debt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_percentage,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_percentage,
    AVG(julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365 AS average_age,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ca.card_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS card_ownership,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
    AVG(t.balance) AS average_account_balance
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    card ca ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    a.district_id = 1
    AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY 
    d.A2;

WITH district_crime AS (
  SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' AND d.A15 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS total_districts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards,
    AVG(d.A15) AS avg_dispositions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS clients_with_loans,
    AVG(CASE WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) < 30 * 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS young_clients,
    AVG(CASE WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) BETWEEN 30 * 365 AND 50 * 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS middle_aged_clients,
    AVG(CASE WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) > 50 * 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior_clients
  FROM 
    district d
  JOIN 
    client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    account a ON c.client_id = a.client_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    card ca ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    disp cl ON a.account_id = cl.account_id
  WHERE 
    d.A15 > 0
  GROUP BY 
    d.district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    male_clients,
    crime_count,
    total_districts,
    total_accounts,
    total_loans,
    total_cards,
    avg_dispositions,
    clients_with_loans,
    young_clients,
    middle_aged_clients,
    senior_clients,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY crime_count DESC) AS rank
  FROM 
    district_crime
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  male_clients,
  crime_count,
  total_districts,
  total_accounts,
  total_loans,
  total_cards,
  avg_dispositions,
  clients_with_loans,
  young_clients,
  middle_aged_clients,
  senior_clients
FROM 
  ranked_districts
WHERE 
  rank = 2;

SELECT 
    c.gender,
    AVG(a.balance) AS avg_balance,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_clients
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    ca.type = 'gold' 
    AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND a.balance > 1000
GROUP BY 
    c.gender;

SELECT 
    COUNT(account_id) AS total_accounts,
    AVG(trans_id) AS average_transactions_per_account,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals,
    AVG(MAX(balance)) AS average_max_balance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS total_credit_cards_issued,
    COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS total_loans_issued,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_active_loan_amounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS number_of_unique_account_owners
FROM 
    account
JOIN 
    disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE 
    district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Pisek')
    AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000 AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(c.card_id) AS number_of_gold_cards,
    AVG(t.balance) AS average_balance,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS number_of_loans,
    AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    disp disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    card c ON disp.disp_id = c.disp_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.type = 'Z' -- Assuming 'Z' represents gold credit cards
GROUP BY 
    a.account_id, d.A2
ORDER BY 
    average_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS region,
    d.A3 AS district,
    c.gender,
    ca.type AS card_type,
    AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_spending,
    AVG(t.amount) / AVG(d.A10) AS spending_to_salary_ratio
FROM 
    trans t
JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
    AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2, d.A3, c.gender, ca.type
ORDER BY 
    d.A2, d.A3, c.gender, ca.type;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM trans AS T1
WHERE T1.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND T1.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1998')

SELECT 
    d.A3 AS district,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.birth_date > '1980-12-31' THEN 'Young'
        WHEN c.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_group,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_clients,
    AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_activity,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'I' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'O' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_active_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id) AS active_loan_rate
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'F' AND d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
GROUP BY 
    d.A3, 
    CASE 
        WHEN c.birth_date > '1980-12-31' THEN 'Young'
        WHEN c.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district,
    AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(t.balance) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN AVG(t.balance) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS customer_priority
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    d.A2 = 'Tabor' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2;

SELECT DISTINCT d.type, AVG(c.salary) AS average_income
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE d.type != 'OWNER' AND dis.A11 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
GROUP BY d.type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND t.bank_to = 'AB';

WITH withdrawal_data AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_withdrawals,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_withdrawal,
    AVG(d.A10) AS unemployment_rate
  FROM 
    trans t
  JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE 
    t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY 
    d.A2
),
unemployment_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    district_name,
    total_withdrawals,
    total_amount_withdrawn,
    average_withdrawal,
    CASE 
      WHEN unemployment_rate > 2.0 THEN 'High'
      WHEN unemployment_rate BETWEEN 1.0 AND 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS unemployment_category
  FROM 
    withdrawal_data
)
SELECT 
  district_name,
  total_withdrawals,
  total_amount_withdrawn,
  average_withdrawal,
  unemployment_category,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_withdrawn DESC) AS rank
FROM 
  unemployment_categories;

SELECT AVG(T1.A15) AS average_crimes
FROM district AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.A15 > 4000
  AND T2.date >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS classic_credit_card_holders,
    AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount,
    AVG(t.balance) AS average_account_balance,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_performance,
    d.A10 AS district_salary,
    d.A11 AS unemployment_rate
FROM 
    district d
JOIN 
    client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN 
    disp disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    disp.type = 'OWNER' AND c.gender = 'M' AND a.frequency = 'classic'
GROUP BY 
    d.district_id, d.A2, d.A10, d.A11;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday(c.birth_date) - julianday('1970-01-01') < 30 * 365 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN julianday(c.birth_date) - julianday('1970-01-01') BETWEEN 30 * 365 AND 50 * 365 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_good_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_bad_loans
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M' 
    AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Prague')
GROUP BY 
    age_group;

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM card 
     WHERE type = 'credit' AND disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date < '1998-01-01')) AND issued < '1998-01-01') * 100.0 / 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM card 
     WHERE type = 'credit' AND disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date < '1998-01-01'))) AS overall_percentage,
    
    (SELECT district.A3, 
            (SELECT COUNT(*) 
             FROM card 
             WHERE type = 'credit' AND disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date < '1998-01-01')) AND issued < '1998-01-01' AND card.card_id = card.card_id) * 100.0 / 
            (SELECT COUNT(*) 
             FROM card 
             WHERE type = 'credit' AND disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date < '1998-01-01')) AND card.card_id = card.card_id) AS region_percentage
     FROM district
     JOIN disp ON district.district_id = disp.district_id
     JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
     WHERE card.type = 'credit' AND card.issued < '1998-01-01'
     GROUP BY district.A3)

SELECT 
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) < 30 * 365 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) BETWEEN 30 * 365 AND 50 * 365 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_category,
    (SUM(t.amount) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'expense' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(t.amount) * 100 AS savings_rate,
    d.A10 AS unemployment_rate,
    l.amount AS largest_loan_amount
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
GROUP BY 
    c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A10, l.amount;

SELECT 
    d.A15 AS crimes_1995,
    d.A16 AS crimes_1996,
    (d.A16 - d.A15) * 100.0 / d.A15 AS crime_change_percentage,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id = 532) AS loan_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 532) AS transaction_count,
    (SELECT AVG(A15) FROM district) AS avg_crimes_1995,
    (SELECT AVG(A16) FROM district) AS avg_crimes_1996,
    (SELECT AVG((A16 - A15) * 100.0 / A15) FROM district) AS avg_crime_change_percentage
FROM 
    district d
JOIN 
    account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE 
    a.account_id = 532;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    AVG(c.salary) AS average_salary,
    t.type AS transaction_type,
    t.operation AS transaction_operation,
    t.amount AS transaction_amount,
    t.balance AS transaction_balance,
    t.date AS transaction_date,
    l.status AS loan_status,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.duration AS loan_duration,
    l.payments AS loan_payments,
    o.bank_to AS order_bank_to,
    o.account_to AS order_account_to,
    o.amount AS order_amount,
    o.k_symbol AS order_k_symbol,
    o.date AS order_date
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE 
    o.order_id = 33333
GROUP BY 
    d.A2, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.date, l.status, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, o.bank_to, o.account_to, o.amount, o.k_symbol, o.date;
SELECT * FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3356 AND operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A10 AS salary_rank,
    ca.card_id,
    ca.type AS card_type,
    ca.issued,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses,
    CASE 
        WHEN ca.type = 'Gold' THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN ca.type = 'Classic' AND julianday('now') - julianday(ca.issued) > 1825 THEN 'Long-term Classic'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS customer_segment
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON c.client_id = l.client_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON c.client_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 13539
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, d.A10, ca.card_id, ca.type, ca.issued;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = d.district_id) AS clients_in_region
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 3541
GROUP BY 
    a.account_id, d.A2
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC;

SELECT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY COUNT(l.loan_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2,
    d.A3,
    d.A4,
    d.A5,
    d.A6,
    d.A7,
    d.A8,
    d.A9,
    d.A10,
    d.A11,
    d.A12,
    d.A13,
    d.A14,
    d.A15,
    d.A16,
    o.bank_to,
    o.account_to,
    o.amount,
    o.k_symbol,
    l.status,
    t.type,
    t.operation,
    t.amount,
    t.balance,
    t.k_symbol,
    t.bank,
    t.account,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS num_credit_cards
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE 
    o.order_id = 32423
GROUP BY 
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) AS total_occurrences
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
most_common_bond AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM bond_counts
  ORDER BY total_occurrences DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
molecule_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
unique_element_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
  FROM atom a1
  JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common_bond)
),
molecule_labels AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common_bond)
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT 
  bc.bond_type,
  bc.total_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mbc.molecule_id) AS molecules_containing,
  AVG(mbc.bond_count) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.ep1) AS unique_element_pairs,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ml.label) AS molecule_labels
FROM 
  bond_counts bc
JOIN 
  most_common_bond mcb ON bc.bond_type = mcb.bond_type
JOIN 
  molecule_bond_counts mbc ON bc.bond_type = mbc.bond_type
JOIN 
  unique_element_pairs u ON bc.bond_type = u.bond_type
JOIN 
  molecule_labels ml ON bc.bond_type = ml.bond_type
GROUP BY 
  bc.bond_type, bc.total_occurrences;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.atom_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT a2.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a1
JOIN bond b ON a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id = b.atom_id1
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND a2.atom_id = b.atom_id2
WHERE (a1.element = 'i' OR a2.element = 'i') AND (a1.element = 's' OR a2.element = 's') AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR181';

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'f')) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS average_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id) AS average_bonds_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 2 WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 3 END) OVER () AS average_bond_strength
FROM 
  molecule
JOIN 
  atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN 
  bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
GROUP BY 
  molecule_id;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+';

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR000_2_5';

SELECT 
    a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY m.label
LIMIT 5;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(molecule_id) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2) AS unique_element_pairs,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(b.bond_id) > 1 THEN 'Multiple times' ELSE 'Once' END AS frequency_status,
    m.label
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN 
    connected c ON b.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
GROUP BY 
    b.bond_type
ORDER BY 
    bond_count DESC;

JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.nationality = 'French' AND r.laps > 50;

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN T1.nationality = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS completion_percentage
FROM 
    drivers AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE 
    T2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT AVG(T1.milliseconds / 1000.0) AS average_time_seconds, T2.year
FROM results AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid
JOIN driverstandings AS T3 ON T1.driverid = T3.driverid AND T1.raceid = T3.raceid
WHERE T3.position = 1 AND T2.year < 1975 AND T1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY T2.year;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.dob > '1975-12-31' AND r.rank = 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId)
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian' AND r.time IS NULL;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(T1.lap) AS fastest_lap_number
FROM lapTimes AS T1
JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId AND T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.year = 2009 AND T2.position = 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.fastestLapSpeed) AS average_fastest_lap_speed
FROM results AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T2.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2009;

SELECT r.name, r.year
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY res.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year < 1985 AND T2.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    COUNT(T2.driverId) AS percentage
FROM 
    drivers AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE 
    T2.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId)
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French' AND lt.milliseconds < 120000;
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American';
SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE YEAR = 2009;
SELECT COUNT(driverId) FROM results WHERE raceId = 18;

SELECT 
    drivers.code,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN drivers.nationality IN ('Netherlandic', 'Dutch') THEN 1 END) AS netherlandic_count
FROM 
    drivers
ORDER BY 
    drivers.dob DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Robert' AND surname = 'Kubica';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid
JOIN laptimes l ON r.resultid = l.resultid
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND d.dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverid
ORDER BY fastest_lap_time ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT driverRef
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
ORDER BY dob ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.dob LIKE '1971%' AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL;

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, l.time
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Spanish' AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.dob) < '1982'
ORDER BY l.time DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT year
FROM races
JOIN results ON races.raceId = results.raceId
WHERE fastestLap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT driverId
FROM lapTimes
WHERE lap = 1
ORDER BY time ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM results 
JOIN status ON results.statusid = status.statusid 
WHERE raceid BETWEEN 50 AND 100 AND statusid = 2 AND time IS NOT NULL;
SELECT name, location, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Austria';

SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS finisher_count
FROM results
WHERE time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY raceId
ORDER BY finisher_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 23 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    r.year, 
    r.name, 
    r.date, 
    r.time
FROM 
    races r
JOIN 
    qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid
JOIN 
    drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE 
    (d.dob, q.qualifyid) IN (
        SELECT 
            d.dob, 
            MIN(q.qualifyid)
        FROM 
            drivers d
        JOIN 
            qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid
        GROUP BY 
            d.dob
    )
ORDER BY 
    r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId)
FROM results r
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE s.status = 'Puncture' AND d.nationality = 'American';

SELECT c.name, c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
ORDER BY cs.points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
WHERE cs.wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM constructorStandings);

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, l.time
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'France' AND r.round = 3
ORDER BY l.time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT raceId, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM lapTimes
WHERE position = 1
GROUP BY raceId
ORDER BY fastest_lap_time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.fastestLapTime) AS average_fastest_lap_time
FROM results AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId
WHERE T1.rank < 11 AND T2.year = 2006 AND T3.country = 'United States';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, AVG(ps.duration) AS avg_duration
FROM drivers d
JOIN pitStops ps ON d.driverId = ps.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND d.dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY avg_duration ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.time
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.position = 1;

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
ORDER BY cs.points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT forename, surname, url, dob
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
ORDER BY dob DESC;
SELECT location, country, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Hungaroring';

SELECT c.points, co.name, co.nationality
FROM constructorStandings c
JOIN constructors co ON c.constructorId = co.constructorId
JOIN races r ON c.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
ORDER BY c.points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(points) 
FROM results 
JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId 
JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId 
WHERE drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND races.country = 'Turkey';

SELECT nationality
FROM drivers
GROUP BY nationality
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY res.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT circuits.name, circuits.location, circuits.country
FROM circuits
JOIN races ON circuits.circuitid = races.circuitid
ORDER BY races.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.round = 3 AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND q.position = 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, r.name
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid
JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MIN(dob) FROM drivers)
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count
FROM results
JOIN status ON results.statusid = status.statusid
JOIN races ON results.raceid = races.raceid
WHERE races.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND status.status = 'Accident';

SELECT COUNT(wins), forename, surname
FROM drivers
JOIN driverStandings ON drivers.driverId = driverStandings.driverId
ORDER BY dob ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(duration) AS longest_pit_stop_duration FROM pitStops;
SELECT MIN(time) AS fastest_lap_time FROM lapTimes;

SELECT MAX(T1.duration) AS longest_time
FROM pitStops AS T1
JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT lap
FROM pitStops
JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN races ON pitStops.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2011;

SELECT drivers.surname, drivers.forename, pitStops.duration
FROM pitStops
JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN races ON pitStops.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.year = 2011 AND races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT MAX(T1.milliseconds) AS lap_record
FROM lapTimes AS T1
JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid
WHERE lt.time = (SELECT MIN(time) FROM laptimes);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.position
FROM results AS T1
JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid
WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.fastestlap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.fastestlapspeed DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.time) AS lap_record
FROM lapTimes AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId
WHERE T3.country = 'Austria' AND T3.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix';

SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, MIN(r.fastestLapTime) AS lap_record
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
GROUP BY c.name;

SELECT r.name AS race_name
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE c.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
ORDER BY res.fastestlapspeed DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.duration
FROM pitStops p
JOIN results r ON p.driverId = r.driverId AND p.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN races ra ON p.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria' AND ra.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix' AND p.time = r.fastestLapTime;

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM circuits c
JOIN (
    SELECT raceId, MIN(time) AS fastest_time
    FROM lapTimes
    GROUP BY raceId
) lt ON c.circuitId = lt.raceId
WHERE lt.fastest_time = '1:29.488';

SELECT AVG(milliseconds)
FROM pitStops
JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT AVG(milliseconds) AS average_lap_time
FROM lapTimes
JOIN circuits ON lapTimes.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
WHERE circuits.country = 'Italy';
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY crossing DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS losses
FROM Match
WHERE season = '2015/2016' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal
GROUP BY home_team_api_id
ORDER BY losses ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.penalties DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T2.team_long_name
FROM `Match` AS T1
JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
JOIN League AS T3 ON T1.league_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND T1.season = '2009/2010' AND T1.away_team_goal > T1.home_team_goal
GROUP BY T2.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.birthday)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', T1.birthday)) AS age
FROM 
    Player AS T1
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE 
    T2.sprint_speed >= 97 
    AND T2.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

SELECT L.name, COUNT(M.match_api_id) AS match_count
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
GROUP BY L.id
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date LIKE '2010%'
  AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE date LIKE '2010%');
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE date LIKE '2012%')
AND T2.date LIKE '2012%';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', Player.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

SELECT L.name, SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(T1.long_shots) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name, AVG(PA.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 4) = '2014'
GROUP BY T1.team_long_name
HAVING AVG(T2.chanceCreationPassing) > T2.chanceCreationPassing
ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY L.name
HAVING AVG(M.home_team_goal) > AVG(M.away_team_goal);
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

SELECT T1.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT T2.buildUpPlayPositioningClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag';

SELECT T1.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND T1.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT T1.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND T1.date LIKE '2011%'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player
ORDER BY birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id 
WHERE Player.weight < 130 AND Player_Attributes.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT T1.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky';

SELECT T1.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'David Wilson';

SELECT T1.birthday
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT AVG(home_team_goal) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id 
WHERE Country.name = 'Poland' AND Match.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) OR p.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) > '1990';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010'
AND pa.overall_rating > 80;

SELECT potential
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id

SELECT player_name FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id

SELECT T2.buildUpPlayPassingClass

SELECT T1.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T1

SELECT AVG(Player_Attributes.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating

SELECT AVG(overall_rating)

  AND Match.date BETWEEN '2008-08-01' AND '2008-10-31';

SELECT T1.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T1

FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

    (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN T1.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END)) -
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN T1.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END)) AS difference

    Player_Attributes AS T1

SELECT team_long_name FROM Team WHERE team_short_name = 'GEN';

SELECT player_name, birthday
FROM Player

LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.name

SELECT L.name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)

JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986' AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'High';

SELECT T1.heading_accuracy

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
